name: What should I prepare before starting a custom basement design consultation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting a custom basement design consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a designer or contractor, document how you plan to use the space, determine must-have functional zones, and note existing basement mechanicals. Measure approximate ceiling heights and take photos of visible structural posts, support beams, sump pumps, and water heaters. It also helps to inspect your foundation walls and slab for any past signs of moisture, cracking, or seepage, as structural or waterproofing issues must be resolved before framing begins. Having a realistic budget range and gathered design inspiration helps streamline your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify how you plan to use the space, note structural elements like support posts and plumbing stacks, check for moisture issues, and establish your budget range.
